outcome: Serum HDL cholesterol in mg/dL, raw scale
predictors: b=(BMI-25)/5; a=(age-50)/10; female=1 for source sex code 2
estimation: Survey weighted least squares with WTMEC2YR; stratified PSU Taylor linearized covariance, full positive-weight MEC spine retained; no FPC
confidence_intervals: Two-sided 95% t intervals; df = domain PSUs minus domain strata minus (model rank minus 1). Degrees of freedom and full/domain design counts are reported; no CI if df<=0.
comparison: Report every frozen endpoint for true and all generated draws, differences and absolute differences in mg/dL; between-draw median/range is descriptive, not inferential superiority. No thresholds or composite success score.
secondary_distribution_checks: After unlock only: weighted mean, SD, 10th/50th/90th weighted quantiles and weighted BMI-HDL correlation; same definitions for true and generated data
prohibitions: No target-dependent exclusions, transformations, model changes, sign filters, selective endpoints, significance-based claim, or calibration to held-out labels
uncertainty: Synthetic survey intervals condition on generated outcomes; they are not calibrated uncertainty about the unobserved true feature. Draw spread does not automatically include evidence, model or transport uncertainty.
claims: A descriptive pilot of analysis recovery, not a causal analysis, individual outcome recovery, or proof of autonomous scientific discovery
